- [`FlareChart`](components/flare-components-flarechart.md) — Draws a data set as SVG: line, area, bar, stacked bar, combo, scatter, bubble, pie, donut, radar, rose, polar area or heat map. The drawing is written by the component itself - there is no charting library behind it and no JS on the render path - so it prerenders, themes from tokens like every other component, and costs one render tree rather than a canvas handoff. Sizing has two modes: Fluid (the default) measures the plot and fills it exactly, so the chart is Height px tall at any width; Fluid="false" fixes the Width x Height aspect ratio and scales the drawing into its container with no interop at all.

- [`FlareColumn`](components/flare-components-flarecolumn.md) — One data column of a FlareDataGrid: what to read from a row, how to display and edit it, and which of sorting, filtering, grouping and aggregation it takes part in. Declaring it registers the column with the enclosing grid, band or composite row - the markup is a description, not the cells themselves, which the grid draws.
- [`FlareColumnBand`](components/flare-components-flarecolumnband.md) — A heading that spans several columns, turning a flat header into a banded one. It draws no cells of its own: nested columns and bands register into it, and the grid reads that tree to lay the header rows out. Bands may nest to any depth.
- [`FlareColumnBase`](components/flare-components-flarecolumnbase.md) — Shared heading node of a FlareDataGrid: the geometry, identity and pinning every kind of header carries, whether it ends up drawing cells (a column) or only grouping others (a band or a composite row). Declaration order is captured at construction, so the grid can rebuild the header tree in the order the markup states it.
- [`FlareColumnRow`](components/flare-components-flarecolumnrow.md) — One visual line inside a composite column - the way several fields of a record are stacked in a single cell instead of spread across columns. The fields declared in it are laid out left to right; the row itself renders nothing.
- [`FlareCombobox`](components/flare-components-flarecombobox.md)
- [`FlareComponentBase`](components/flare-components-flarecomponentbase.md) — Base class for all Flare components. Provides theme access via cascading parameters and automatic re-renders when the theme changes (via CascadingValue pattern, not subscriptions).
- [`FlareConfirmDialogProvider`](components/flare-components-flareconfirmdialogprovider.md) — Host for the confirmation dialogs raised through IConfirmDialogService. It cascades itself, so anything beneath it can take the service as a cascading parameter and await a yes/no answer instead of wiring up a dialog and its state.
- [`FlareContainer`](components/flare-components-flarecontainer.md)
- [`FlareDataGrid`](components/flare-components-flaredatagrid.md) — FlareDataGrid partial: column-band (grouped header) layout logic.
- [`FlareDataGridFilterPresets`](components/flare-components-flaredatagridfilterpresets.md) — Named advanced filters offered as a single choice, so a reader picks "Overdue" instead of rebuilding its condition tree. Choosing an entry applies that filter group to the FlareDataGrid; the leading empty entry clears it.
- [`FlareDataGridPager`](components/flare-components-flaredatagridpager.md) — Page navigation for a FlareDataGrid, placed wherever the layout wants it rather than where the grid would put it. The grid keeps owning the page and page size - the data concern - while this owns how paging is presented. It renders nothing when there is nothing to navigate: a virtualized or infinite-scroll grid, or a single page with no page-size choice.
- [`FlareDataGridQuickFilter`](components/flare-components-flaredatagridquickfilter.md) — A debounced search box that narrows a FlareDataGrid to the rows where any visible column contains the typed text, case-insensitively. Placed in the grid's toolbar it finds the grid through the cascade; anywhere else it is pointed at one explicitly.

## Enums

- [`Flare.Components.AggregateType`](enums/flare-components-aggregatetype.md) — Aggregate function type applied to a column's numeric values.
- [`Flare.Components.AlertSeverity`](enums/flare-components-alertseverity.md) — Severity of a FlareAlert, controlling its color and icon.
- [`Flare.Components.AlertVariant`](enums/flare-components-alertvariant.md) — Visual display variant of a FlareAlert.
- [`Flare.Components.AvatarShape`](enums/flare-components-avatarshape.md) — Shape of FlareAvatar.
- [`Flare.Components.AvatarSize`](enums/flare-components-avatarsize.md) — Size of FlareAvatar (shared Xs..Xl scale; Md is the default).
- [`Flare.Components.BadgeAnchor`](enums/flare-components-badgeanchor.md) — Corner of the anchor element where the badge indicator is placed.
- [`Flare.Components.BadgeOrigin`](enums/flare-components-badgeorigin.md) — Corner position of the badge indicator relative to its anchor element.
- [`Flare.Components.BadgeOverlap`](enums/flare-components-badgeoverlap.md) — Shape of the anchor element that determines how the badge indicator overlaps its edge.
- [`Flare.Components.BarcodeSymbology`](enums/flare-components-barcodesymbology.md) — The 1D symbologies FlareBarcode can encode, ordered by how often they are actually asked for rather than alphabetically.
- [`Flare.Components.BottomNavPosition`](enums/flare-components-bottomnavposition.md) — How FlareBottomNav sits in the page.
- [`Flare.Components.Breakpoint`](enums/flare-components-breakpoint.md) — A responsive viewport tier on the shared Xs..Xxl scale. The values are the discrete tiers only; range comparisons (at-least / at-most / between) are expressed with the strongly typed helpers on BreakpointExtensions rather than being baked into the enum. Default lower bounds (see FlareBreakpoints): Xs 0, Sm 600, Md 960, Lg 1280, Xl 1920, Xxl 2560 (px). The bounds are configurable per subscription and via FlareOptions.
- [`Flare.Components.ButtonEdge`](enums/flare-components-buttonedge.md) — Optical edge alignment for an icon/toggle button: a negative inline margin that pulls the button toward the container edge so its icon lines up with adjacent content (app bars, toolbars, list-item leading/trailing slots).
- [`Flare.Components.ButtonShape`](enums/flare-components-buttonshape.md) — Corner shape of a button, orthogonal to its variant. Every value resolves to per-theme shape tokens, so a shape looks native in whichever theme is active.
- [`Flare.Components.ButtonSize`](enums/flare-components-buttonsize.md) — Size of a FlareButton on the shared Xs..Xl scale (Md is the default).
- [`Flare.Components.ButtonType`](enums/flare-components-buttontype.md) — HTML button type attribute values.
- [`Flare.Components.ButtonVariant`](enums/flare-components-buttonvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareButton.
- [`Flare.Components.CardActionsAlign`](enums/flare-components-cardactionsalign.md) — Alignment of FlareCardActions content along the row (or column, when vertical).
- [`Flare.Components.CardActionsStack`](enums/flare-components-cardactionsstack.md) — Card width below which FlareCardActions stacks its actions. These are CONTAINER widths, not viewport breakpoints: what decides whether two buttons fit side by side is how wide the card is, so a card in a narrow column stacks on a wide screen too.
- [`Flare.Components.CardSize`](enums/flare-components-cardsize.md) — Overall scale of a FlareCard. Controls the corner radius and the inner gap between stacked anatomy slots, resolving to the active theme's shape scale so the size looks native in every theme.
- [`Flare.Components.CardVariant`](enums/flare-components-cardvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareCard, independent of the active theme. Each theme reskins the variants through its CardTokens, so a variant looks native everywhere (e.g. Tonal is a soft secondary-container fill). The five names mirror ButtonVariant (Filled/Outlined/Text/Elevated/Tonal).
- [`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationKind`](enums/flare-components-chartannotationkind.md) — The kind of overlay a ChartAnnotation draws.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationLabelPosition`](enums/flare-components-chartannotationlabelposition.md) — Where an annotation's label sits relative to the annotation itself.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationLayer`](enums/flare-components-chartannotationlayer.md) — Which side of the data an annotation is drawn on.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartLegendPosition`](enums/flare-components-chartlegendposition.md) — Where the legend sits relative to the plot in FlareChart.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartLineStyle`](enums/flare-components-chartlinestyle.md) — Stroke pattern of a line, trend line or annotation. The dash arrays behind the patterned values are theme tokens (--flare-chart-line-dash-*), so a theme retunes them without touching a call site.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartScaleMode`](enums/flare-components-chartscalemode.md) — What the plot does when a series is switched off in the legend.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartSeriesKind`](enums/flare-components-chartserieskind.md) — How a single series draws in a Combo chart.
- [`Flare.Components.ChartType`](enums/flare-components-charttype.md) — The kind of chart FlareChart renders from its data.
- [`Flare.Components.ChipSize`](enums/flare-components-chipsize.md) — Size of FlareChip (shared Xs..Xl scale; Md is the default).
- [`Flare.Components.ChipVariant`](enums/flare-components-chipvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareChip, independent of the active theme. Provides three chip styles: Outlined (the default - a bordered, transparent chip), Filled (a solid surface fill with no border) and Elevated (a filled surface lifted by a drop shadow).
- [`Flare.Components.ColorFormat`](enums/flare-components-colorformat.md) — Output format for the color value produced by FlareColorPicker.
- [`Flare.Components.ColumnAlign`](enums/flare-components-columnalign.md) — Horizontal text alignment of a column's header and cells. Values are logical (writing-direction aware), so End is the right edge in LTR and the left edge in RTL.
- [`Flare.Components.ColumnDataType`](enums/flare-components-columndatatype.md) — Semantic data type of a column. Drives type-aware cell rendering (boolean as a checkbox icon, culture/format-aware dates and numbers) and the default inline filter editor. The default, Auto, infers the type from the column's runtime cell values.
- [`Flare.Components.ColumnFilterType`](enums/flare-components-columnfiltertype.md) — Inline filter editor rendered in a column's filter-row cell.
- [`Flare.Components.Combobox.CommitKind`](enums/flare-components-combobox-commitkind.md) — The outcome of a commit intent, so the shell can forward the right consumer callback.
- [`Flare.Components.CompositeMode`](enums/flare-components-compositemode.md) — How a composite column (FlareColumn with a Composite) lays out its fields.
- [`Flare.Components.ConnectorVariant`](enums/flare-components-connectorvariant.md) — Line style of the connector between timeline items.
- [`Flare.Components.ContainerMaxWidth`](enums/flare-components-containermaxwidth.md) — Maximum width constraint applied to layout containers such as FlareContainer and the content area of FlareLayout / FlareLayoutContent. Each value (except Full) caps the width and centers the content horizontally.
- [`Flare.Components.DataGridChange`](enums/flare-components-datagridchange.md) — What changed in a DataGridContext, as a bit mask. Raised by Changed and matched against FlareDataGridControl<TItem>.Observes so a control re-renders only for the changes it actually shows. Reading the changed values is a separate, explicit step: the notification carries flags rather than a state snapshot so a burst of keystrokes in a filter box costs no allocation.
- [`Flare.Components.DataGridEditMode`](enums/flare-components-datagrideditmode.md) — Edit mode for the DataGrid.
- [`Flare.Components.DataGridFilterMode`](enums/flare-components-datagridfiltermode.md) — Controls how column filters are displayed in the DataGrid.
- [`Flare.Components.DataGridLoadingIndicator`](enums/flare-components-datagridloadingindicator.md) — How a FlareDataGrid shows its loading state.
- [`Flare.Components.DataGridSelectionMode`](enums/flare-components-datagridselectionmode.md) — Selection mode for the DataGrid.
- [`Flare.Components.DateRangePickerMode`](enums/flare-components-daterangepickermode.md) — How a FlareDateRangePicker presents the range selection.
- [`Flare.Components.DateTimeVariant`](enums/flare-components-datetimevariant.md) — Layout of the FlareDateTimePicker popup.
- [`Flare.Abstractions.DialogCloseReason`](enums/flare-abstractions-dialogclosereason.md) — Why a dialog is being dismissed - passed to a BeforeClose guard so it can decide whether to allow or veto the close (e.g. block a scrim click while there are unsaved changes).
- [`Flare.Abstractions.DialogPosition`](enums/flare-abstractions-dialogposition.md) — Where a component dialog is anchored within the viewport. Center is the classic centered modal; Bottom presents the same component-dialog contract as a slide-up bottom sheet (full-width, rounded top corners, optional grabber handle, safe-area padding).
- [`Flare.Abstractions.DialogSize`](enums/flare-abstractions-dialogsize.md) — Maximum-width size presets for a Flare dialog (FlareDialog / a component dialog).
- [`Flare.Components.DividerInset`](enums/flare-components-dividerinset.md) — Inset style of a FlareDivider.
- [`Flare.Components.DividerTextAlign`](enums/flare-components-dividertextalign.md) — Controls alignment of the text label inside a FlareDivider.
- [`Flare.Components.DrawerAnchor`](enums/flare-components-draweranchor.md) — Screen edge a FlareDrawer is anchored to.
- [`Flare.Components.DrawerVariant`](enums/flare-components-drawervariant.md) — Display variant for FlareDrawer.
- [`Flare.Components.DropEdge`](enums/flare-components-dropedge.md) — Where a drop landed relative to the item under the pointer.
- [`Flare.Components.DropPlacement`](enums/flare-components-dropplacement.md) — What a FlareDropZone accepts, which is also what the drop resolves to.
- [`Flare.Components.DynamicVariant`](enums/flare-components-dynamicvariant.md) — Dynamic-color scheme variant - how the source (seed) color is expanded into tonal roles.
- [`Flare.Components.FabMenuDirection`](enums/flare-components-fabmenudirection.md) — Direction a FlareFloatingActionMenu expands from its FAB.
- [`Flare.Components.FabPosition`](enums/flare-components-fabposition.md) — Placement mode for a FlareFloatingActionButton.
- [`Flare.Components.FabSize`](enums/flare-components-fabsize.md) — Size of a FlareFloatingActionButton. The steps are labels, not measurements: each theme maps them onto its own padding and radius tokens, so what a step is worth depends on the theme in use.
- [`Flare.Components.FieldMargin`](enums/flare-components-fieldmargin.md) — Vertical (block) margin applied around a text field (FlareField / FlareTextField), mirroring the dense/normal spacing presets common in form layouts.
- [`Flare.Components.FieldSize`](enums/flare-components-fieldsize.md) — Size of a form field control (input, select, multi-select). Medium is the default.
- [`Flare.Components.FilterOperator`](enums/flare-components-filteroperator.md) — Operator applied by a structured DataGridFilter.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareAlignItems`](enums/flare-components-flarealignitems.md) — CSS align-items values for flex containers.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareCodeSeverity`](enums/flare-components-flarecodeseverity.md) — How badly wrong a marked span is.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareColorRole`](enums/flare-components-flarecolorrole.md) — Semantic color roles shared across Flare components.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareIconMorph`](enums/flare-components-flareiconmorph.md) — How FlareIconView transitions from one glyph to the next when its value changes. The outgoing and incoming glyphs are cross-faded in place - what differs between the modes is the movement layered on top of that fade, and how far it travels is the theme's call (the --flare-icon-morph-* tokens).
- [`Flare.Components.FlareJustifyContent`](enums/flare-components-flarejustifycontent.md) — CSS justify-content values for flex containers.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareSize`](enums/flare-components-flaresize.md) — Unified size scale for Flare components. Use this for new components. Existing components may have their own size enums for backward compatibility.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareSpacing`](enums/flare-components-flarespacing.md) — Design-token spacing values for gap, padding, and margin parameters. Maps to pre-compiled CSS modifier classes using the component's spacing scale.
- [`Flare.Components.FlareUploadState`](enums/flare-components-flareuploadstate.md) — Where one file stands in an upload queue.
- [`Flare.Components.Combobox.FocusStrategy`](enums/flare-components-combobox-focusstrategy.md) — Which option to highlight when the dropdown opens.
- [`Flare.Components.FontWeight`](enums/flare-components-fontweight.md) — Font weight override for FlareText. Default keeps the weight defined by the active type scale; the other values map to the standard CSS numeric weights via shared flare-text--weight-* classes (no inline style needed).
- [`Flare.Components.FormLayout`](enums/flare-components-formlayout.md) — Controls the visual layout of form fields inside a FlareForm.
- [`Flare.Components.GaugeShape`](enums/flare-components-gaugeshape.md) — How a FlareGauge lays its scale out. One component with three shapes rather than three components: the scale, bands, ticks, target marker and readout are the same in all three, and only the projection from value to screen differs.
- [`Flare.Components.IDE.IdePanelMode`](enums/flare-components-ide-idepanelmode.md) — Controls how a docked tool panel in FlareIdeLayout behaves when expanded.
- [`Flare.Components.ImageObjectFit`](enums/flare-components-imageobjectfit.md) — How a FlareImage is fitted into its box (maps to CSS object-fit).
- [`Flare.Components.InputVariant`](enums/flare-components-inputvariant.md) — Visual variant of a text field (FlareField, FlareNumericField, FlareTextArea), independent of the active theme. Default keeps the theme's own field style.
- [`Flare.Components.LabelPlacement`](enums/flare-components-labelplacement.md) — Position of a control's label relative to the control (checkbox, radio, switch).
- [`Flare.Components.LayoutContentAlignment`](enums/flare-components-layoutcontentalignment.md) — Horizontal placement of a width-capped content frame within the available area of FlareLayout / FlareLayoutContent. Only has a visible effect when the content is narrower than the available width (i.e. a ContainerMaxWidth cap is applied); at full width there is no free space to distribute.
- [`Flare.Components.LinkTabsVariant`](enums/flare-components-linktabsvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareLinkTabs bar, independent of the active theme. Mirrors the pill-shaped variants of TabsVariant (Tonal/Filled) so a row of route links can read as the same segmented control as an in-page FlareTabs, reusing the same --flare-tabs-* design tokens.
- [`Flare.Components.LinkUnderline`](enums/flare-components-linkunderline.md) — When a FlareLink shows its underline.
- [`Flare.Components.MaskPreset`](enums/flare-components-maskpreset.md) — Ready-made mask patterns for FlareMaskedField. When set (and no explicit Mask is given), the corresponding pattern is used. Pattern tokens: # digit, A letter, * alphanumeric.
- [`Flare.Components.MenuActivation`](enums/flare-components-menuactivation.md) — How a FlareMenu is opened from its activator.
- [`Flare.Components.MenuAnchor`](enums/flare-components-menuanchor.md) — Corner of the activator that the FlareMenu dropdown panel aligns to, and the direction in which it opens. Logical (RTL-aware) aliases are also provided.
- [`Flare.Components.Combobox.MenuTrigger`](enums/flare-components-combobox-menutrigger.md) — What user gesture opens the dropdown.
- [`Flare.Abstractions.MessageBoxKind`](enums/flare-abstractions-messageboxkind.md) — The kind of message box to display.
- [`Flare.Components.NavMatchMode`](enums/flare-components-navmatchmode.md) — How a nav link's href is matched against the current URL to decide the active state.
- [`Flare.Components.NavMenuMode`](enums/flare-components-navmenumode.md) — How a FlareNavMenu presents its items. Set it explicitly to control the menu independently of any surrounding FlareLayout; leave it unset to keep the legacy behavior (driven by Rail or the collapsed layout drawer).
- [`Flare.Components.PaginationSize`](enums/flare-components-paginationsize.md) — Size of FlarePagination controls. Medium is the default and matches the Xs..Xl scale used across Flare components (e.g. FlareButton, form fields).
- [`Flare.Components.PickerOpenTo`](enums/flare-components-pickeropento.md) — The initial calendar view a date picker opens to. Year jumps straight to the year grid - handy for far-back dates like a date of birth so the user does not page through months.
- [`Flare.Components.PopoverPlacement`](enums/flare-components-popoverplacement.md) — Side and alignment a FlarePopover is placed relative to its anchor.
- [`Flare.Components.PopoverTrigger`](enums/flare-components-popovertrigger.md) — How a FlarePopover is opened.
- [`Flare.Components.ProgressVariant`](enums/flare-components-progressvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareProgress indicator.
- [`Flare.Components.QrErrorCorrectionLevel`](enums/flare-components-qrerrorcorrectionlevel.md) — QR code error correction level. Higher levels allow more data recovery at the cost of reduced capacity.
- [`Flare.Components.ResizableEdge`](enums/flare-components-resizableedge.md) — Which edge of a FlareResizable carries the drag handle.
- [`Flare.Components.IDE.RibbonSizeMode`](enums/flare-components-ide-ribbonsizemode.md) — Size mode for the ribbon - collapsed shows only tabs, full shows tabs + commands.
- [`Flare.Components.ScrollAlign`](enums/flare-components-scrollalign.md) — Where a scrolled-to element should come to rest in the visible area.
- [`Flare.Components.ScrollAxis`](enums/flare-components-scrollaxis.md) — Which axis a direction filter reacts to.
- [`Flare.Components.ScrollBehavior`](enums/flare-components-scrollbehavior.md) — How the browser should animate a programmatic scroll.
- [`Flare.Components.ScrollDirection`](enums/flare-components-scrolldirection.md) — Which way a scroll container moved between two notifications. One enum for both axes: a vertical reading only ever yields None, Up or Down, and a horizontal one only None, Left or Right.
- [`Flare.Components.Combobox.SelectionMode`](enums/flare-components-combobox-selectionmode.md) — How many items a combobox may hold selected at once.
- [`Flare.Components.SelectionMode`](enums/flare-components-selectionmode.md) — How many rows a FlareDataGrid lets the user select.
- [`Flare.Components.SkeletonAnimation`](enums/flare-components-skeletonanimation.md) — Loading animation of a FlareSkeleton placeholder.
- [`Flare.Components.SkeletonVariant`](enums/flare-components-skeletonvariant.md) — Shape of a FlareSkeleton placeholder.
- [`Flare.Abstractions.SnackbarPosition`](enums/flare-abstractions-snackbarposition.md) — Anchor position of the snackbar stack on screen.
- [`Flare.Abstractions.SnackbarSeverity`](enums/flare-abstractions-snackbarseverity.md) — Severity of a snackbar notification, controlling its accent color and icon.
- [`Flare.Components.SortDirection`](enums/flare-components-sortdirection.md) — Sort direction applied to a data-grid column.
- [`Flare.Components.StepperOrientation`](enums/flare-components-stepperorientation.md) — Layout orientation of a FlareStepper.
- [`Flare.Components.SubmenuPlacement`](enums/flare-components-submenuplacement.md) — Placement of the submenu relative to the parent item.
- [`Flare.Components.SwitchSize`](enums/flare-components-switchsize.md) — Size of FlareSwitch on the shared Xs..Xl scale; medium is the default. The steps are labels, not measurements - each theme maps them onto its own track and thumb tokens, and they differ: one theme's medium switch is not another's.
- [`Flare.Components.TabInteractionType`](enums/flare-components-tabinteractiontype.md) — The kind of tab interaction reported to FlareTabs.OnPreviewInteraction.
- [`Flare.Components.TabLabelRotation`](enums/flare-components-tablabelrotation.md) — Rotation applied to each tab's label in FlareTabs.
- [`Flare.Components.IDE.TabOverflowBehavior`](enums/flare-components-ide-taboverflowbehavior.md) — Behaviour when document tabs overflow the available width.
- [`Flare.Components.TabsPlacement`](enums/flare-components-tabsplacement.md) — Side of the content the FlareTabs bar is placed on.
- [`Flare.Components.TabsVariant`](enums/flare-components-tabsvariant.md) — Visual style of a FlareTabs bar, independent of the active theme. Each theme reskins the variants through its tokens, so a variant looks native everywhere (e.g. Filled is a solid accent pill). Four names mirror ButtonVariant (Text/Tonal/Filled/Outlined).
- [`Flare.Components.TextAlign`](enums/flare-components-textalign.md) — Horizontal text alignment for FlareText. Default inherits the surrounding alignment; the other values map to text-align via shared flare-text--align-* classes (no inline style needed).
- [`Flare.Components.TextAreaResize`](enums/flare-components-textarearesize.md) — Controls the user-drag resize affordance of a FlareTextArea (the CSS resize property). Ignored when AutoGrow is on (auto-sizing owns the height).
- [`Flare.Abstractions.Tokens.ThemeDelivery`](enums/flare-abstractions-tokens-themedelivery.md) — How theme/palette CSS reaches the document.
- [`Flare.Abstractions.Tokens.ThemeMode`](enums/flare-abstractions-tokens-thememode.md) — Light/dark selection for a theme. A theme carries both schemes (via its palette); the mode chooses which one is active. Auto follows the OS preference. HighContrast uses a high-contrast color scheme for accessibility.
- [`Flare.Components.TimePickerVariant`](enums/flare-components-timepickervariant.md) — Visual style of the FlareTimePicker popup.
- [`Flare.Components.TimeSpanUnits`](enums/flare-components-timespanunits.md) — Which segments a FlareTimeSpanPicker shows. Flags rather than a "smallest unit" enum: a field can legitimately show days and minutes and skip hours, and an ordered scale cannot say that.
- [`Flare.Components.TimelineAlign`](enums/flare-components-timelinealign.md) — Which side of the rail FlareTimeline items are placed on.
- [`Flare.Components.IDE.ToolPanelPosition`](enums/flare-components-ide-toolpanelposition.md) — Position of a tool panel within the IDE layout.
- [`Flare.Components.TooltipPlacement`](enums/flare-components-tooltipplacement.md) — Side of the anchor a FlareTooltip is placed on.
- [`Flare.Components.TrackSize`](enums/flare-components-tracksize.md) — The size step of a track-based indicator - FlareSlider, FlareProgress and FlareMeter - on the shared Xs..Xl scale. The scale is a set of LABELS, not measurements: each component maps a step onto its own per-size tokens, and each theme decides what those are worth. A slider's Md is a chunky drag target while a progress bar's Md is a few pixels of rule - the same step, deliberately different geometry. What the shared scale does guarantee is that the three stay in step with each other within one theme, and that a caller learns one vocabulary instead of three. The DEFAULT step is per component, because the components' natural sizes sit at different points of their own ranges: a slider defaults to Xs (its canonical thin-track form), while a progress bar and a meter default to Md - a rule and a spinner want room to go finer as well as heavier, so their resting size sits mid-scale rather than at the floor.
- [`Flare.Components.TreeDropPosition`](enums/flare-components-treedropposition.md) — Position where an item is dropped relative to the target.
- [`Flare.Components.Combobox.TriState`](enums/flare-components-combobox-tristate.md) — Tri-state of a "select all" affordance over the currently visible, enabled options.
- [`Flare.Components.TypographyScale`](enums/flare-components-typographyscale.md) — Semantic type-scale roles mapped to semantic HTML elements and CSS utility classes.
